messages.subject: Executive CV Submission | External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Stakeholders
messages.body:
Dear Qiddiya Talent Acquisition Team,

Please accept my executive CV for consideration for current and future leadership opportunities with Qiddiya Investment Company across External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and related country-facing leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director within the Social Responsibility Department of AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, where my mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social responsibility, corporate coordination, compliance, executive communications and strategic stakeholder engagement. My experience includes senior engagement with ministries, regulators, industry bodies, communities and strategic partners, together with cross-functional coordination across complex operating and investment environments.

Qiddiya's scale, public-private interface and role within Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 align strongly with the type of stakeholder-intensive leadership work I have performed throughout my career. I am internationally mobile and available on a 30-day notice period.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would welcome consideration for mandates where my background in institutional relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and executive coordination would support Qiddiya's development and operating priorities.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
